Hi team —

I sketched a compact cadence to keep the day tight and leave explicit 15-min debrief windows after panels. Can everyone check availability and confirm scribe rotation? - 09:30–10:00 — System design (Soojin)
- 10:15–10:45 — Algorithmic / coding (Karthik)
- 11:00–11:30 — Product/behavioral (Marissa)
- 11:45–12:00 — Debrief with panel (internal only)

- Karthik/Soojin, please confirm you’re comfortable with the 15-min buffer between panels (candidate needs a short break).
- Ivy, I’ve attached a short runbook and the invite stub — if these times don't work, please reply with preferred mornings.
